release_notes:
# v0.1.15 - observation-only diagnostic
YouTube 21.30.216 only. Existing filter source and separate opt-in diagnostic source are retained.
Diagnostic Manager source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rikunode/youtube-view-count-filter-patches/main/diagnostic/patches-bundle.json

- P0: source dispatch, ghost provenance and enum presence/value.
- P1: six actual Lakmq.c selection returns and model/container identity boundaries.
- P2: direct and deferred child/row bridge reference evidence; unknown paths remain unjoined.
- Discovery reservation: 2,000 pre-target + 8,936 discovery + 64 edge_d_2 within the existing 11,000-event / 4 MiB bulk cap. Discovery loss marks discoveryIncomplete and blocks interpretation.
- Filter DEX, implementation classes and extension are byte-identical to v0.1.14.

Original instructions, branches/switches, register layout and try counts verified. Filter-only / official-only / conflict guard and standalone / missing-predicate fixtures verified.
